patterns.name: Curve evaluation
patterns.note: Pure evaluation throughput: the pattern GPU is built for. Each thread interpolates one point from the uploaded spline coefficients.

patterns.name: Market-quote PV01 ladders
patterns.workload: 4 trades × 119 market quotes bumped 1bp, curve family re-bootstrapped per bump
patterns.note: The honest result: 99.7% of the wall clock is sequential curve re-bootstrapping on CPU, and the only part GPU touches is the repricing, which is already milliseconds. Accelerating the pricing kernel cannot move an end-to-end number that is dominated by bootstrap.

patterns.name: Zero / forward PV01
patterns.note: Same shape as the market ladder: the bump-and-rebuild loop is sequential and dominates; repricing across 16 CPU threads costs 4ms.
